Container.Name: Nextcloud
Container.Overview:
Nextcloud Hub - the open-source self-hosted productivity platform.
This template runs the official Nextcloud Apache image. It is designed to work alongside the companion templates "Nextcloud-DB" (MariaDB) and "Nextcloud-Redis" on a shared user-defined Docker network named "nextcloud-net".
Quick setup: 1. Create the network once on the Unraid host: docker network create nextcloud-net 2. Install Nextcloud-DB first (it runs as the database) 3. Install Nextcloud-Redis (used for memcache + file locking) 4. Install this Nextcloud template 5. Front it with a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager / SWAG / Traefik) for HTTPS
Pairs nicely with the standalone MCP-Nextcloud template in this same repo to expose Nextcloud APIs to AI assistants (OpenClaw, Claude Desktop, etc.) over Model Context Protocol.
Container.Requires: You must create a user-defined Docker network named "nextcloud-net" on the host before launching this template: docker network create nextcloud-net Also requires the Nextcloud-DB and Nextcloud-Redis containers from this same repo.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port that your reverse proxy will forward to

Config.Name: User Data
Config.Description: User file storage. A dedicated cache+array share is recommended; do NOT keep this in /appdata for production.

Config.Name: MYSQL_HOST
Config.Description: Container name of the MariaDB instance on the same Docker network

Config.Name: MYSQL_DATABASE
Config.Description: Database name (must match what was set on Nextcloud-DB)

Config.Name: MYSQL_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Database password (must match the one you set on Nextcloud-DB)

Config.Name: REDIS_HOST
Config.Description: Container name of the Redis instance on the same Docker network

Config.Name: REDIS_HOST_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Redis password (must match the one you set on Nextcloud-Redis)

Config.Name: NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN_USER
Config.Description: Initial admin username (only used at first install)

Config.Name: NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Initial admin password (only used at first install — rotate after first login!)

Config.Name: NEXTCLOUD_TRUSTED_DOMAINS
Config.Description: Space-separated list of hostnames Nextcloud will accept (e.g. 192.168.1.100 nc.example.com)

Config.Name: OVERWRITEPROTOCOL
Config.Description: Protocol Nextcloud should believe it is served over (https when behind a reverse proxy)

Config.Name: OVERWRITEHOST
Config.Description: Public hostname Nextcloud should believe it is served as (e.g. nc.example.com)

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: IP address of your reverse proxy (e.g. 192.168.1.50 if NPM lives there)
